sources.entry: App Downloader - Easily search and download macOS apps from the huge homebrew cask app catalog.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that searches the Homebrew cask catalog and links each result to the publisher's original download location.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you search for macOS apps in the Homebrew cask catalog. For each search result it shows the publisher's original download URL. Pressing the URL opens the download in your web browser. The download locations come from the homebrew-cask contributors. The README lists open TODO items: fixing the settings window, verifying the SHA256 hash of downloaded files, and searching with Cmd-F. The README does not describe how the app is built or what it requires beyond macOS.
use_cases: Find macOS apps by name from the Homebrew cask catalog
Get the publisher's official download link for a Mac app
Browse available Homebrew cask apps without using the terminal
Download macOS apps through the web browser
how_to_run: Get the latest version from the release page
notable: Shows original publisher download URLs rather than hosting files itself
Built on the Homebrew cask catalog
Downloads open in the user's web browser
caveats: macOS only, per the README's trademark note and purpose
Settings window fix and SHA256 verification are listed as TODO, not done
Download locations depend on homebrew-cask contributors and may be outdated
